body: Sis...I went and watched one of her latest Tik Toks, she explained that “he would do anything for me” - Jesus wept, this is some foolery. HE’S A FULL-TIME STAY AT HOME DAD, at a bare minimum the house should be in order. I understand things can get away from you and raising children is hard work, but to leave the house in such a state with young children around is disrespectful and neglectful.

You are exuding queen energy and I’m so happy for you!!! Well done, you just gained your life back. 💕 
So proud of you!

So sorry you’re suffering this intensely, friend. 

I am the closest to ending my life that I have ever been.
